review.notes: Full review. Seeded sample of 15 targets checked against E06, CE, GN, ST, Venjakob, E11, Nakamura, Pan22, LLHLM, Fu and MilneSV (about 45 locators); all hold except the CE p.8 gloss at 7.4 and 7.5 (C01). Corrections E1-E5 confirmed in the source texts. Gate rerun OK; depcheck with --movable: 200 roadmaps, 2207 edges, 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with one sorry warning; all 83 library names resolve at the pins. R01: completedHeckeLocalTopology duplicates Mathlib's Localization.ringTopology instance (not defeq; #synth picks the roadmap instance; the file elaborates without it). R02: F.4 re-owns locally analytic vectors of Banach representations owned by PadicLocalLanglandsForGL2Qp section 0.1 on main. The previous review's ALS.5 remark is repaired. The change summary's added declaration 'for' is a docstring word, a scanner false positive.
